subject: On-prem SKU matrix and service-levels discussion — BluePeak
messages:
From: Samira Khan <skhan@bluepeak.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@bluepeak.com
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: BluePeak RFP + on-prem SKU clarifications

Hi Vanessa / Rafael / Priyom,

Thanks again for the kickoff earlier today. I attached BluePeak's RFP so you have the formal asks and timelines. A few immediate clarifications we need to make progress on procurement:

- SKU mapping: we need a clear mapping from your hosted API SKUs to the on-prem / VPC SKUs (per-GPU seat vs. per-concurrent-request).
- Platform fee: is this a fixed annual fee or a percentage of committed spend? Can you outline scenarios where it can be waived or credited?
- Support tiers: we need response and escalation SLAs for Production and Business hours, and pricing for an 'Enterprise Plus' support add-on that includes 24/7 on-call and a named technical account manager.
- Migration credits: do you provide one-time credits for migration and integration services? If so, typical ranges would help us budget.

We'd like a draft SKU/pricing matrix and an initial SOW estimate by EOD Wednesday (our procurement window is tight). Also attaching the RFP: BluePeak_RFP_20260629.pdf.

Best,
Samira Khan
Procurement Lead, BluePeak Systems
Samira.khan@bluepeak.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <skhan@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BluePeak RFP + on-prem SKU clarifications

Samira — thanks for the clear list. We're aligned on timeline; attaching a first-pass SKU proposal (BP_SKU_Proposal_v1.xlsx) and an explanatory note. High-level answers up front:

- SKU mapping: our on-prem offering is priced on a pool model: reserved GPU pools (monthly compute SKU) + optional per-concurrent-request routing (burst SKU) for spiky workloads. The proposal maps three common consumption profiles (steady, bursty, enterprise) to suggested pool sizes and expected token throughput.
- Platform fee: standard is an annual platform fee (covers control plane, telemetry, and security integrations) expressed as a flat USD amount per environment. Typical range: $35k-$150k depending on scope. We can discuss limited waivers or credits tied to committed reserved capacity.
- Support tiers: we offer Standard (business hours), Premium (24/7 with 2hr P1), and Enterprise Plus (named TAM, on-site options, 1hr P1). Pricing details are in the attached.
- Migration credits: we do provide one-time migration credits for multi-year commitments; commonly $10k–$50k depending on scope.

Open questions for you to help us size the proposal: expected RPS and average sequence length, any data residency / network constraints, and whether you plan to self-manage KMS/HSM or have us integrate with your key management.

I'll be in the office most of the day; Rafael and Priyom will add the pricing schedule and potential concession options.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Attachment: BP_SKU_Proposal_v1.xlsx

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <skhan@bluepeak.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BluePeak RFP + on-prem SKU clarifications — pricing schedule

Samira — following up with the attached pricing schedule (BP_Pricing_Schedule_20260629.pdf). A few concrete items from our side:

- Platform fee mechanics: flat annual fee per private deployment. Example tiers: $35k (small), $75k (mid), $150k (enterprise). The fee covers control plane, telemetry retention to 90 days, and basic integrations.
- Discounts: standard discounts apply on reserved GPU capacity: 12% for 12-mo commit, 18% for 24-mo, 22% for 36-mo. We can offer an additional 3% if BluePeak takes Platform + Enterprise Plus support at 36 months.
- Migration credit: for deals over $500k ARR in committed value, we typically provide $25k–$50k one-time migration credit. For smaller pilots we can do up to $10k.
- Payment terms: Net 30 by default; Net 45/60 may be available with purchase order.

We can bend on a one-month platform fee waiver for new customers that sign an initial 24+ month reservation, subject to revenue threshold. If you want, I can queue a formal concession memo for approval (deal_id: BP-2026-07).

Rafael Mendes
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
Attachment: BP_Pricing_Schedule_20260629.pdf

From: Samira Khan <skhan@bluepeak.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@bluepeak.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 08:56:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BluePeak RFP + on-prem SKU clarifications — follow-up

Thanks Vanessa / Rafael — this is helpful and moves us forward. A couple of asks from procurement and security before we kick off SOW: 

1) Platform fee concession: BluePeak requests a waiver of the first billing month of the platform fee (not a full year) as a go-live credit. That helps internal sign-off.
2) Migration credit: given our initial scope (pilot + phased rollout), we're asking for a $25k migration credit applied at invoice.
3) SOC 2 evidence: we need your SOC 2 Type II report and a short note on how audit logs are retained in the private VPC offering.

If you can confirm items 1 and 2 and supply SOC2 artifacts, we'll fast-track procurement. We expect to provide a PO within two weeks if terms are confirmed.

Regards,
Samira Khan
Procurement Lead, BluePeak Systems

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <skhan@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BluePeak RFP + on-prem SKU clarifications — confirmation and next steps

Samira — appreciate the clear ask. Confirming concessions we can commit to today (subject to final SOW):

- Platform fee: we can apply a one-month platform fee waiver as a go-live credit tied to the initial purchase order.
- Migration credit: we will apply a $25,000 one-time migration credit at first invoice for the scope described; this aligns with Rafael's standard concession thresholds.
- SOC 2: attaching a secure link to our SOC 2 Type II report and a short note on private VPC log retention and KMS options. (I'll send the secure link via separate email to your security contact this afternoon.)

Next steps: Rafael/Legal will prepare a compact SOW (BP_SOW_Draft.docx) that captures the agreed SKUs, platform fee treatment, migration credit, and support tier (Enterprise Plus add-on priced as outlined). Once you confirm the SOW, we'll send a DocuSign packet for signatures and a concession memo will be routed internally referencing deal_id BP-2026-07.

If acceptable, can we schedule a 30-minute wrap-up call tomorrow at 10am PT to finalize the SOW?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Attachment: BP_SOW_Draft.docx
